display.title: T3: The 5x Ore Chain
display.subtitle: Enrich, purify, inject, crystallize
description: This is the reward the whole Engineering lane builds toward: §b5x ore§r.
Mekanism climbs there one step at a time, each new machine set in front
of the last: the §bEnrichment Chamber§r doubles ore, the
§bPurification Chamber§r makes it 3x, the §bChemical Injection Chamber§r
Build an §bEnrichment Chamber§r to start: this quest completes when
you hold one. Every later step still ends in it.
§7This 5x chain is the Tier 3 infrastructure reward and the point of
every machine you built below. Enrichment Chamber §e60§7 tokens each.
